criterion: which assistant-command intent the utterance expresses, that is what the user wants done

categories.name: Set Alarm
categories.definition: Create a new alarm for a specific time or interval.

categories.name: Query Alarm
categories.definition: Ask for information about existing alarms.

categories.name: Manage Alarm
categories.definition: Modify, delete, snooze, or control an existing alarm.

categories.name: Set Timer
categories.definition: Create a new countdown timer.

categories.name: Query Timer
categories.definition: Ask for information about existing timers.

categories.name: Manage Timer
categories.definition: Modify, delete, pause, resume, or control an existing timer.

categories.name: Set Reminder
categories.definition: Create a new reminder for a specific task or event.

categories.name: Query Reminder
categories.definition: Ask for information about existing reminders.

categories.name: Manage Reminder
categories.definition: Modify, delete, or control an existing reminder.

categories.name: Initiate Call
categories.definition: Start a phone or video call with one or more contacts.

categories.name: Manage Call
categories.definition: Control an ongoing call, such as answering, hanging up, adding/removing participants, or switching modes.

categories.name: Query Call History
categories.definition: Ask for information about past calls, such as missed calls or call times.

categories.name: Query Call Status
categories.definition: Ask for information about the current call status, such as who is calling.

categories.name: Send Message
categories.definition: Send a text or video message to one or more contacts or groups.

categories.name: Query Message
categories.definition: Ask for information about received messages.

categories.name: Play Media
categories.definition: Start playing music, podcasts, or other audio/video content.

categories.name: Manage Media Playback
categories.definition: Control ongoing media playback, such as stopping, skipping, or fast-forwarding.

categories.name: Set Media Preferences
categories.definition: Configure default media applications or playback settings.

categories.name: Query Weather
categories.definition: Ask for current or forecasted weather information for a location.

categories.name: Query News
categories.definition: Ask for news headlines or details on specific topics.

categories.name: Query General Knowledge
categories.definition: Ask for factual information, recipes, definitions, or how-to instructions.

categories.name: Query Contact Information
categories.definition: Ask for details about contacts, such as address, phone number, employer, online status, or relationships.

categories.name: Query Events
categories.definition: Ask for information about upcoming or past events, activities, or entertainment options.

categories.name: Manage Event RSVP
categories.definition: Respond to an event invitation by accepting or declining.
